story.heading: Our Story
paragraphs: Datla Infra builds premium apartments and thoughtfully designed communities in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh. Every project starts with the same question: what would make this a home someone is proud of, not just a building someone bought?

From Subhadra Residency, our first completed community, to the communities now under construction and on the drawing board, we've stayed close to the fundamentals — honest construction, clear communication, and handing over keys on the date we promised.

vision: To be Vijayawada's most trusted name in residential real estate — recognised for craftsmanship, transparency and communities people are proud to call home.
mission: To design and deliver premium apartments on time, every time, using honest construction practices and materials built to last for generations.
